source: The ADJ_SCHEMA constant, the GROUPS constant, the shared INPUTS text and the Adjudicate stage prompt of the workflow script omniroute-routing-convergence-record, a private file under ~/.claude. Copied after the stages ran; this copy does not show that the rule was frozen before them, only what the script held. Script paths are masked: $SCRATCH is the session scratch directory.

stage.dispatch: one agent per group, run through the workflow's pipeline(); each returns JSON under item_schema

groups.ids: P1 P2 P3 P4 P5 P6 P7 P8

P17 P18 P19 P20 P21 P22 P23, the ADD-P1P7/ADD-LIVE items, R1-R8, E1-E9, U1-U4, and the missed practices from JOB 1 and JOB 2 (sub2api owner-aware previous_response_id routing; previous_response_id removal on failover; configuration_update effort validation; keepalive and forward-compatible fields; quota scoping by metered limit)

prompt: Adjudicate the routing practices <group ids> for the GPT-6 Codex account-pool lane behind OmniRoute (20128 shared, 20129 full-compression lane chained to it).
- Compare the Claude catalog entry, the GPT-6 JOB 2 verdict on it, and whether GPT-6 JOB 1's independent answer reached the same practice.
- Apply every GPT-6 amendment you can check against its cited source; open the cited source in the pinned clones under $SCRATCH/src when a claim is contested.
- "converged" means both families agree with checked sources;
- "disagreement" means one refutes and the conflict is unresolved;
- "single_family" means only one family has it;
- "not_checked" means GPT-6 did not check it.
- Map the item to OmniRoute's current state from route-mapper-final.json (file:line), and decide the action. Actions already taken:
- the occupancy patch (P1/P7/P19/P18 exposure): approved_pending, to apply after R02;
- everything the C- and K-series verdicts hold: kept_as_is.
- Give a verify metric and an overturn condition for each.
- Numbers only from the input files; name the file for each number. Do not invent measurements.

shared_inputs.note: input_files_with_receipts names each input the stages read (path masked, description shortened from the script) and the receipt that now holds it. live_state_facts is verbatim.
input_files_with_receipts: $SCRATCH/omni-full/route-landscape-catalog.json: the Claude research catalog P1-P22, plus addendum_2026_09_28 (P23 client disconnect / 499; the P1/P7 clarification; the withdrawn 8.4% finding, replaced by route-mapper's 10.3%). Receipt: route-landscape-catalog.json.
$SCRATCH/omni-full/route-gpt6/gpt6/route-job1/last.json: GPT-6 (gpt-6-astra, effort max, exit 0) independent answer; it never saw the catalog. Receipt: route-job1.last.json.

$SCRATCH/omni-full/route-gpt6/gpt6/route-job2/last.json: GPT-6 (same model and effort, exit 0) refutation of the catalog. Receipt: route-job2.last.json; runner metadata and usage in route-gpt6-runs.json.
$SCRATCH/omni-full/route-mapper-final.json: OmniRoute dd6e9607e mechanism inventory, 24 h live metrics on 20128 and 20129, and the P1-P23 mapping. Receipt: route-mapper-final.json.
$SCRATCH/omni-full/route-mapper-resume-parts.md: check 1, check 2, part 1 (interim) and part 3. Receipt: route-mapper-resume-parts.md.
$SCRATCH/omni-full/route-landscape-occupancy-research.md: the cited minimal fix and the user decision. Receipt: route-landscape-occupancy-research.md.
$SCRATCH/omni-full/maintenance-gh-20260928.tsv: gh api default-branch last-commit dates. Receipt: maintenance-gh-20260928.tsv.
$SCRATCH/omni-full/limiter/apply.json: the 20129 limiter PATCH with its read-back. Receipt: limiter-apply-20129.json (reduced).
$SCRATCH/omni-full/TRACKER.md: the coordinator's decision log. Not published; its decision facts are in decisions.json.
live_state_facts: 20129: chained to 20128 via provider node sharedgw; its limiter is now disabled (enabled true -> false).
The occupancy patch is being built in a separate workflow (upstream tests, new prefix). It will be applied only after R02, so its status here is "approved; acceptance pending; apply after R02".

gpt6_position.description: JOB 2 verdict plus JOB 1 agreement or absence

adopted_rule.description: the final practice text after applying amendments

upstream_sources.description: repo@commit:file:lines or URLs; maintained per the tsv

omniroute_state.description: 20128 and 20129 state from route-mapper, with file:line
